shortDescription: Manages volumes on Apache CloudStack based clouds.

options.name: account
options.description: Account the volume is related to.

options.name: api_http_method
options.description: HTTP method used to query the API endpoint. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_METHOD) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_key
options.description: API key of the CloudStack API. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_KEY) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_secret
options.description: Secret key of the CloudStack API. If not set, the C(CLOUDSTACK_SECRET) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: HTTP timeout in seconds. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_TIMEOUT) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_url
options.description: URL of the CloudStack API e.g. https://cloud.example.com/client/api. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_ENDPOINT) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_verify_ssl_cert
options.description: Verify CA authority cert file. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_VERIFY) env variable is considered.

options.name: custom_id
options.description: Custom id to the resource. Allowed to Root Admins only.

options.name: device_id
options.description: ID of the device on a VM the volume is attached to. Only considered if I(state) is C(attached).

options.name: disk_offering
options.description: Name of the disk offering to be used. Required one of I(disk_offering), I(snapshot) if volume is not already I(state=present).

options.name: display_volume
options.description: Whether to display the volume to the end user or not. Allowed to Root Admins only.

options.name: domain
options.description: Name of the domain the volume to be deployed in.

options.name: force
options.description: Force removal of volume even it is attached to a VM. Considered on I(state=absent) only.

options.name: format
options.description: The format for the volume. Only considered if I(state=uploaded).

options.name: max_iops
options.description: Max iops

options.name: min_iops
options.description: Min iops

options.name: mode
options.description: Mode for the volume extraction. Only considered if I(state=extracted).

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the volume. I(name) can only contain ASCII letters.

options.name: poll_async
options.description: Poll async jobs until job has finished.

options.name: project
options.description: Name of the project the volume to be deployed in.

options.name: shrink_ok
options.description: Whether to allow to shrink the volume.

options.name: size
options.description: Size of disk in GB

options.name: snapshot
options.description: The snapshot name for the disk volume. Required one of I(disk_offering), I(snapshot) if volume is not already I(state=present).

options.name: state
options.description: State of the volume.

options.name: tags
options.description: List of tags. Tags are a list of dictionaries having keys I(key) and I(value). To delete all tags, set a empty list e.g. I(tags: []).

options.name: url
options.description: URL to which the volume would be extracted on I(state=extracted) or the URL where to download the volume on I(state=uploaded). Only considered if I(state) is C(extracted) or C(uploaded).

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If V(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_DANGEROUS_NO_TLS_VERIFY) env variable is considered. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: vm
options.description: Name of the virtual machine to attach the volume to.

options.name: zone
options.description: Name of the zone in which the volume should be deployed.
